name: South East Technological University
summary: Technological university across Waterford, Carlow and Wexford: about 85 honours degrees via CAO, from Engineering and Law to Nursing and Sport.

ib.text: Six subjects with English (or Irish); Maths only where a course names it. Some ask more: Engineering Maths SL 6 or HL 4; Pharmacy HL 5 in Chemistry and in a second lab science (2026-entry pages).

programmes.name: Veterinary Medicine
programmes.about: A new five-year veterinary degree in Waterford that moves from animal biology and welfare through disease diagnosis, clinical medicine and surgery to professional practice, with placements in small and large animal clinics and hospitals.
programmes.ib: HL 5 in two subjects, one of them Chemistry or Biology, and SL 4 in four more, including English and Maths. 60 hours of animal work experience.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. Places go on CAO points, after 60 hours of veterinary or animal-husbandry work experience within three years of applying.

flagshipSource.title: SETU prospectus: Veterinary Medicine is one of two new degrees SETU was chosen to offer from 2026-27

programmes.name: Pharmacy
programmes.about: A five-year integrated Master of Pharmacy in Waterford: drug formulation, pharmacology, patient care and professional ethics, with placements in community and hospital pharmacies and a research project in the final year.
programmes.ib: HL 5 in Chemistry and in Biology or Physics, and SL 4 in four more subjects, including English and Maths.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. Places go on CAO points, with a medical declaration and screening, and police clearance if you lived abroad over 6 months after age 12.

flagshipSource.title: SETU prospectus: Master of Pharmacy is one of two new degrees SETU was chosen to offer from 2026-27

programmes.name: Engineering (Common Entry, Waterford)
programmes.about: One first year to try Automation, Electrical, Electronic, Sustainable Civil and Sustainable Energy engineering, then you pick the honours degree that fits, with a new engineering building under construction in Waterford.
programmes.ib: Maths SL 6 or HL 4, with HL 5 in two subjects and SL 4 in four more, including English.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. Places go on CAO points; IB totals are converted with the CAO's points table.

flagshipSource.title: SETU prospectus: Engineering Common Entry, five BEng (Hons) degrees from one first year

faculties.name: Engineering
faculties.line: Engineering (Common Entry, Waterford) asks Maths SL 6 or HL 4 and two subjects at HL 5 (2026 entry).

faculties.name: Science
faculties.line: Science (Common Entry) asks Maths and English at SL 4; Pharmacy asks HL 5 in Chemistry and in Biology or Physics (2026 entry).

faculties.name: Veterinary, Agriculture, Horticulture and Forestry
faculties.line: Veterinary Medicine asks HL 5 in Chemistry or Biology and 60 hours of animal work experience (2026 entry).

faculties.name: Computing
faculties.line: Computer Science (Common Entry, Waterford) is a four-year degree with streams such as Cloud and Networks.

faculties.name: Business
faculties.line: Business (Common Entry) asks HL 5 in two subjects, plus English and Maths at SL 4; you pick a stream later (2026 entry).

faculties.name: Media, Design and Music
faculties.line: Music (SE206) holds an audition; Art (SE207) combines CAO points with a portfolio (2026 entry).

notes: The same subject is often taught on more than one campus under different CAO codes, so check the campus before you list a code.
Music (SE206) selects by audition; Art (SE207) and the Sports Management and Coaching degrees ask for a portfolio.
